concept.title: Shopping help and errands
concept.shortdesc: Getting help with the weekly shop, errands or shopping trips, and shopping at community or charity shops.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: receiving second-hand furniture and clothing: see (donated goods rather than shopping help)
support with household tasks: see (cleaning and chores)
general support: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (not specific to shopping)

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.76).
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. It would split into help with shopping and errands, and shopping at particular shops such as thrift or gift shops.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-029. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
